procedure: Pages rendered with pdfplumber page.to_image(resolution=220); the five pages are PORTRAIT sheets whose rotated landscape tables read upright after PIL ROTATE_90 (cache/2026-scan-assessment/tier1/choctaw/; this county's rotation is opposite Chickasaw's/Carroll's). Every in-scope row's cross-page cell sum equals its printed TOTAL exactly (13/13).
structure_note: Same two-table shape as the other Tier-1 five-page sheets: p1 is the certification/signature page; p2+p3 = table A over the county's 12 precincts (11 columns, then West Weir + TOTAL) carrying the state-office sections; p4+p5 = table B (same column split) carrying the continuation rows and locals. The SEMS section-continuation split: 'Chancery Court 6-Chancery District 06 Place 2' prints as the LAST header box on p2/p3, and its candidate row (Kiley Catledge Kirk) starts p4 ahead of the local zone -- the Warren p5 carry pattern. Races: U.S. Senate; US House Of Rep 01-1st Congressional District; Court Of Appeals 01-District 1 Position 1 (Derek Dewayne Hopson Jr., John Weddle) and Position 2 (Donna M. Barnes); Chancery Court 6-Chancery District 06 Place 1 (Doug S. Crosby) and Place 2 (Kiley Catledge Kirk) -- the same Chancery 6 roster Attala prints, names identical; Circuit Court 5-Circuit District 05 Place 1 (Joseph H. 'Joey' Loper Jr.) and Place 2 (Alan D. 'Devo' Lancaster) -- the same Circuit 5 roster Attala and Carroll print, names identical. Printed totals: Colom 1033, Hyde-Smith 1964, Pinkins 58, Baucom 56, Cliff Johnson 955, Kelly 2026, Hopson 923, Weddle 1694, D. Barnes 2370, Crosby 2369, Kirk 2389, Loper 2564, Lancaster 2374.
operator_rows_note: All 13 in-scope rows supplied by operator_rows in ballot order; table-A rows carry p2 (eleven precinct cells) + p3 (the West Weir cell + printed TOTAL); Kirk's, Loper's and Lancaster's rows carry p4 + p5 cells + the p5 printed TOTAL. No X cells print in any in-scope row.
truncation_note: No truncations; the twelve precinct headers print complete (Bywy, Chester, District 5, East Weir, French Camp, Hebron, Kenego, Panhandle, Reform, Sherwood, Southwest Ackerman, West Weir).
local_note: p4/p5 carry the local sections after Circuit 5 Place 2: School Board District 1-School Board District 1 Member (Gina Bishop) and School Board District 5-School Board 05 (Earl L. Carter, Shannon Draper) -- all local, out of scope, contributing no parse rows on operator-supply pages.
